messages:
mira: Heads-up: planning a small migration tonight in 00:30-01:00 UTC to drop orders.legacy_meta and validate new index. Plan: dry-run validate, canary slice -> wider roll. Backfill via deploybot with chunking.

jon: Will we pin api-service? If clients still read legacy_meta we should pin to v2.5.x.

mira: Yes pin to v2.5.2 for safety and enable compat flag to return empty metadata.

leo: Abort criteria proposal: any chunk lock_time > 4m OR replication lag > 20s OR temp files > 75% on runner. ops_watch to execute abort.

ops_watch: I'll monitor. If triggered I'll post "ops_watch: ABORT MIGRATION  PAUSE WAVES" and pause deploybot job.

deploybot: migration-job-1775401234 created by mira. Canary: sliceX (50 tenants). Chunk size 8k rows/tx, 1s sleep. Auto-shrink on repeated 2s+ locks.

mira: Smoke checks: 1) sample GET /orders/:id from canary 2) `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE legacy_meta IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1` 3) recent writes > 5m. Abort on any 5xx or large discrepancy.

deploybot: CANARY STARTED on sliceX. logs: "applied 8000 rows in 1.7s, lock_time=110ms"

ops_watch: Canary green so far. Proceed to sliceY.

deploybot: EXPANDING: starting sliceY (200 tenants). chunk log: "applied 8000 rows in 1.9s, lock_time=140ms"

deploybot: ALERT: chunk 9/40 on sliceY reported lock_time=5m10s and runner temp_files=78%.

ops_watch: ABORT MIGRATION  PAUSE WAVES. Pausing migration-job-1775401234. Notifying DB on-call.

mira: Acknowledged. Reverting canary state where safe. Keep api-service pinned.

leo: Root cause likely a hot customer shard touched in that chunk. Next run: add per-shard chunk limits (1k) and sort by id to avoid big temp files. Also preflight validate on replica.

mira: Next steps: keep migration paused, DB to add shard-aware chunker, schedule re-run in a narrower window after dry-run. I'll update release notes and calendar.
